exercises.title: Bring it home
exercises.goal: Get it back on the ground at home before the battery runs low.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home and lands it by itself.

steps.text: Wait for it to land at home.

exercises.title: Read the panel
exercises.goal: Answer three questions from Telemetry: how high it is, its mode and its battery.

steps.text: Find its height above home in Telemetry and answer.

questions.text: How high is it above home?

exercises.unavailable: Practice needs a simulated vehicle started in UXDuck.

exercises.title: Get started
exercises.goal: A first flight: send it somewhere, change its mode, bring it home and land.

steps.text: Right-click the map, or press and hold it, and choose Fly here.
steps.hint: Fly here sends it to the place you chose and holds it there.
